items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know he loved Ellington, because we used to talk about it all the time... the other dates that we did after that date

ctx.x: Gary McFarland was a very, very suave, debonair, young, talented cat who – I know he loved Ellington, because we used to talk about it all the time. He was just a nice cat. He was a rather dangerous living cat. He’d – was wasting himself playing Russian roulette with a drink. He takes the – a person like him or Joe Maini. Joe Maini did it with a gun. Spin it around and walked to a cat’s house. Bam. Blew his brains all over the house. This cat did it with a drink. Three card Monty – switch switch switch switch –…
